#### [The Liu lab website is launched today!!](news_labwebsite.qmd)

#### We are thrilled to announce the launch of our laboratory website today. Through this platform, we will be sharing updates on our research topics, laboratory news, and other activities. We are going through the feeling of eventually coming home.

#### 2024.8.16

#### [Dr. Tian Liu received brand New R01 and R03 awards from NIH/NIA](R01_R03_awards "awards")

#### We are thrilled to share with that Dr. Tian Liu has been awarded the R01 and R03 grants from the National Institutes of Health/NIA for the 5-year and 2-year projects, respectively. We are excited to honor this wonderful achievement!

#### 2024.11.11

#### [Dina Bugybayeva joins the lab as an Research Assistant](Welcome_Dina! "Welcome Dina!")

#### We are pleased to have Dina as a Research Assistant in our lab. We're hoping she'll have fun and learn more about Neuroscience research. 

#### 2024.11.18

#### [Welcome Teresa Thomas!](Welcome_Teresa!)

#### We are excited to announce Teresa's arrival to our lab as a Research Assistant. Welcome on board, Teresa!

#### **2025.01.11**

#### [Congratulations to Liam for being admitted to the BSTP doctoral program at CWRU!](congratulations)

The Liu Lab 'senior statesman', Liam Wetzel, has been accepted by the BSTP program for his PhD study. Congratulations, Liam!

#### 2025.07.08

#### [Welcome William Samsa!](welcome%20William%20Samsa)

We are pleased to have William Samsa as an Research Associate at the Liu lab. Welcome on board, Will!

#### 2025.08.04

#### [Welcome Kexin Zhang and Ching-Yao Yang!](Welcome%20Kexin%20Zhang%20and%20Ching-Yao%20Yang!)

We are excited that Kexin and Ching-Yao started working at the Liu lab as research assistants.

#### 2026.01.01

#### [Dr. Tian Liu received a New R21 award from NIH/NIA](R21%20award)

We are delighted to announce that Dr. Tian Liu has been awarded the R21 grant from the National Institutes of Health/NIA for a 2-year project, which will allow us to further expand our research projects.

#### 2026.01.30

#### [Liam received a T32 award](Liam%20received%20a%20T32%20award)

We are excited to announce that Liam has been appointed to the Alzheimer’s Disease Translational Data Science Training Program (T32). Congratulations!

#### 2026.07.04

#### [New paper published](https://advanced.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/advs.76205)

We are pleased to announce that our paper has been published in *Advanced Science*. Congratulations to Teresa and Ching-Yao!
